Resume FAQ

Can I edit these templates for free?

Yes. Editing, previewing, and PDF downloads are free.

Do I need an account to download?

No. You can save your finished resume as a PDF without signing in.

Which template should I choose?

Choose the layout that gives your most relevant experience enough room and matches the expectations of your target role.
